theme_archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (Adapted for Dark Cinematic Expedition)
vibe: Snow mountains, night sky, glaciers, altitude, premium adventure, awe-inspiring, trustworthy

rules.headings: uppercase, tracking-tight, font-black for heroes (text-5xl to text-7xl), font-bold for sections.
rules.body: leading-relaxed, text-base to text-lg, high legibility.
rules.accents: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs to text-sm, font-bold for overlines and labels.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. High visual impact. The 'Bento' grid for features and gallery sections.

grid_modes.marketing: The 'Tetris' Grid (asymmetry, visual tension, gap-8 to gap-12)
grid_modes.data: The 'Control Room' Grid (density for trek itineraries, gap-4 to gap-6)

surfaces.navbar: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#020617]/60 border-b border-white/10 rounded-full mx-auto mt-4 w-[95%] max-w-7xl sticky top-4 z-50
surfaces.cards: Solid background #071827 with a delicate 1px border (border-white/10). No soft shadows, instead rely on border and slight hover lift (-translate-y-1).
surfaces.hero_overlay: Cinematic gradient: bg-gradient-to-t from-[#020617] via-[#020617]/50 to-transparent.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift (-translate-y-2) with subtle glow. Text color shifts to Glacier Blue. Buttons scale active (scale-95).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Smooth scroll enabled. Staggered fade-up entrances for bento grids.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow, smooth, organic drift. Avoid fast ticking. Professional and subtle intensity.

component_instructions.buttons: Primary CTA uses Accent Orange (#F97316) for high contrast and conversion. Secondary uses Glacier Blue or transparent with 1px border. MUST have data-testid.
component_instructions.navbar: Floating rounded container, dropdowns for Categories/Destinations. Logo prominently displayed.
component_instructions.hero: Full-screen (min-h-screen). Massive typographic stack layered over image. 1-2 words highlighted in Glacier Blue or Accent Orange.
component_instructions.marquee_gallery: Horizontal scrolling gallery of expedition moments. Subtle, no gaps or minimal gaps.
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn inputs and forms, styled with #071827 backgrounds, #94A3B8 placeholders, and focus rings in Glacier Blue. Success modal upon submission.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.

hero.description: Machhapuchhare starry night, perfect for main landing hero
Trekker looking at distant mountain, good for expeditions hero

brand_assets.description: Abstract topographic map texture for section backgrounds

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme colors and avoid any heavy green theme.
Build the 13 required pages (Home, All Treks/Packages, Trek Detail, Expeditions, Upcoming Departures, Destinations, Categories, About, Safety, Blog, Gallery, Reviews, Contact) as pure frontend pages.
Ensure the hero section uses min-h-screen with large, uppercase typography (font-family: 'Clash Display') overlapping the background image.
Use Lucide React icons where necessary.
Implement glassmorphism on the navbar exactly as specified in the surfaces layout instructions.
Use Framer Motion for subtle hover animations on trek cards and smooth entrances.
Implement the animated horizontal gallery/review marquees using react-fast-marquee or CSS animations with low intensity.
Do not use placeholders for images. Always use the URLs provided in the image_urls section.
Show a success modal specifically when form submissions occur (Enquiry Forms).
All crucial elements must include the 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='booking-submit-btn').
